advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Tātarihia ngā rā kāri mā @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt, @listEnteredAt rānei. Hei tauira: @endAt >= '2026-01-01', @endAt = none rānei. Whakaurua te ingoa o tētahi āpure ritenga e tīmata ana ki @ ki waenga i ngā tohu kīanga.
advanced-filter-description: Mā te Tātari Arā Atu Anō ka taea te tuhi aho whai i ēnei pūwhakahaere: == != <= >= && || ( ) Ka whakamahia he mokowā hei whakawehe i ngā Pūwhakahaere. Ka taea te tātari i ngā Āpure Ritenga katoa mā te pato i ō rātou ingoa me ngā uara. Hei Tauira: Field1 == Value1. Tuhipoka: Ki te whai mokowā ngā āpure, ngā uara rānei, me whakakapi ki ngā tohukī takitahi. Hei Tauira: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Hei peke i ngā pūāhua whakahaere takitahi (' \/), whakamahia \. Hei tauira: Field1 == I\'m. Ka taea hoki te whakakotahi i ngā here maha. Hei Tauira: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ko te tikanga ka whakamāramatia ngā pūwhakahaere katoa mai i mauī ki matau. Ka taea te huri i te raupapa mā te whakamahi taiapa. Hei Tauira: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Ka taea hoki te rapu āpure kuputuhi mā te regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

email-recovery-description: Kotahi te rārangi mō ia kaiwhiwhi. Rapua mā te ID kaiwhakamahi. Kāore ngā ihirangi karere me ngā āpure īmēra o te kaiwhiwhi e whakaaturia. Mā te whakatā e pupuri ngā karere o nāianei me ērā ka tae mai; mā te haere tonu e whakamātau anō te tuku i ngā karere kei te rārangi tatari ināianei. Mā te whakakore e muku ngā karere kua uru ki te rārangi tae noa ki te wā o te tono. Mēnā kei te haere tonu te tuku, whakamātau anō ā muri tata nei. Kāore e taea te whakahoki mai i tētahi karere kua tīmata kē te tuku, ā, tērā pea ka tukuna anō he karere kāore i te mōhiotia te putanga o tōna tukunga. Ka noho ngā rahunga pūmau me ngā karere kua eke ki te tepe whakamātau hei arotake. Mā te whakamātau anō i ngā karere i rahua e tīmata he huringa whakamātau hou, ā, ka mau tonu te whakatā kua whakaritea.
